fixes.subject: religious-studies-aqa
fixes.title: Abortion & Euthanasia
fixes.summary: Qur'an verse attribution corrected. 6:2 does not describe soul-breathing; that concept is in 15:29, 32:9, 38:72. Replacement text uses 32:9 for ensoulment (with correct quotation 'Then He fashioned him and breathed into him of His Spirit'), adds Hanafi/Maliki/Hanbali ensoulment timing (120 vs 40 days), and repositions 6:2 correctly as lifespan appointment. No flashcards or KCs cited 6:2 for the soul-breathing claim — no further changes needed.
